Ever\-expanding technology like IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence means that there’s more structured and unstructured data available today than ever before. As a data engineer, you know that organizing data can yield pivotal insights when it’s gathered from disparate sources. We need an experienced data professional like you to help our clients find answers in their data to impact important missions, from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence.

Here, you’ll mentor a multi\-disciplinary team of analysts, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast\-paced, agile environment. You’ll use your expertise in analytical exploration and data examination while you oversee the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for your clients.

  

Work with us to use data for good.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, InfraEng Platform Team
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------



Infrastructure Engineering builds and runs the foundations Anduril operates on. That includes wired and wireless connectivity, our private backbone, private and public cloud, and the systems that run on them.  

  

The InfraEng Platform Team owns the central hub for all of it: the console, CLI, and API the rest of the company uses to consume infrastructure. We do not build every capability ourselves. Partner teams own their domains, and we help them expose those capabilities through the hub.  

  

We define and champion the shared patterns: one identity model, one authorization model built on RBAC and ABAC, one audit trail, and one set of ergonomics. Partner services meet the contract for their space, and the platform makes that contract easy to meet. The goal is to replace tickets with safe, bounded self\-service across every team and provider.


**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------



You will be the first software engineer on the InfraEng Platform Team and one of the first in Infrastructure Engineering. A small codebase exists today. Part of your early work is deciding whether it is the right foundation to extend or whether to replace it.  

  

From there, you will set the architecture, engineering standar
